item.title: Chroma Context-1: Training a Self-Editing Search Agent
item.description:
📝 Running frontier-scale models for multi-turn search incurs high cost and latency, which motivates offloading this task to a smaller, purpose-trained model. Related Work#The limitations of single-shot retrieval have driven substantial exploration into agentic search systems, in which reasoning is interleaved with retrieval to resolve queries that require satisfying multiple constraints jointly or following a chain of dependent clues across documents. These systems model search as a sequential reasoning task, in which the right next query depends on what.
🔗 Read more: https://www.trychroma.com/research/context-1

item.title: Agent-to-Agent Pair Programming
item.description:
📝 That work led them to create a multi-agent workflow with a main orchestrator assigning tasks to workers. Claude Code “Agent teams” and Codex “Multi-agent” features work similarly, with subagents reporting back to the main agent. It makes this feedback loop faster and more natural, while preserving context across iterations.
🔗 Read more: https://axeldelafosse.com/blog/agent-to-agent-pair-programming

item.title: We rewrote JSONata with AI in a day, saved $500k/year
item.description:
📝 By combining Reco's deep SaaS identity intelligence with Torq's HyperSOC orchestration, the workflow autonomously pulls context from across the security stack — EDR, DLP, SASE, and cloud security — to deliver a confident, natural-language verdict in seconds. 6 min readSaaS SecurityIntroducing Full AI Agent Visibility for SaaSAndrea Bailiff-GushMarch 17, 2026Organizations have thousands of AI agents operating across their SaaS environments, yet security teams have no visibility into what's running or what permissions these agents hold. Reco's AI agent security discovers every agent, maps the connections between systems, and gives teams control to manage risk.
🔗 Read more: https://www.reco.ai/blog/we-rewrote-jsonata-with-ai
